sources.note: Repository PDF newly checked at cover, pp. 1–3 and 16–18. substantive_relations.relationship: Analyzes how institutional production and unequal social positions allow differently coded readings of media.
substantive_relations.note: Own 1973 paper pp. 1–3 and 16–18 read; encoding and decoding are distinct determinate moments. The early paper’s professional-code position and the later revision remain distinct.

substantive_relations.relationship: Treats diasporic identity as historically produced positioning, transformation and difference, alongside the political force of recovery.
substantive_relations.note: Own essay pp. 222–226 read in the qualified scan witness. Hall recognizes the resistance value of recovery while rejecting an eternally unchanged essence; no identity-history founding claim follows.
